title: Trump says 'largely true' Iran war led to Republicans midterm loss
summary: After Democrats won both the House and Senate in a blowout for Republicans, President Trump admitted fuel prices brought on by the Iran war impacted the outcome, but stuck by his decision.
byline: Elizabeth Schumacher, Richard Connor, Karl Sexton, Jenipher Camino Gonzalez, Wesley Dockery, Natalie Muller

image.caption: Trump insisted his unpopular war on Iran was 'the only answer'Image: Evan Vucci/REUTERS

blocks.text: WATCH: Big Democrat victory in US midterm elections
President Donald Trump's Republican Party lost races even in states it had held for decades.
For Democrats, the results surpassed even the most optimistic expectations. They now have control of Congress.
Big Democrat victory in US midterm elections
